title: Claude Lalanne’s bronze monkey armchair with ostrich leather seat sold for $1.079 million
summary_full: Sotheby’s auction in December 2025 saw the sale of a remarkable gilt-bronze armchair by Claude Lalanne, which captured attention with its elaborate vines and monkey embellishments. This particular design, created in 1998, was the pioneer among Lalanne’s 'Singerie' armchairs to attract a successful sale. The high demand for Lalanne's artistry played a crucial role in achieving an impressive sale price through the auction house's consignment system.
